New skill: `paywall-rules`, for coding agents that build or change a paywall or onboarding screen.

- **What the stores require on the screen:** nine must-haves (billed amount most prominent, period, trial terms next to the button, restore and terms links, localized prices, a visible close button, no trial toggle on iOS, truthful claims, an easy way to cancel), each with its rule.
- **What won in published A/B tests** (trial timeline, trial on annual only, real reviews, product previews, clear button copy, value before price, questions that change what follows) and **what lost** (cutting onboarding steps that ask or set up, a loader before a plan screen, a second-chance offer after the main paywall, an "Are you sure?" popup, a price rise on its own), plus a mixed one (a Free vs Pro comparison). Every result links to its source and says how strong it is: A/B, directional or bundled.
- Real discounts and countdowns only, savings rounded down, trial wording only for people still eligible.
- A short R1–R9 check the agent fills in before it finishes.
- Tested with two independent agent runs (a SwiftUI paywall with seven violations; a React Native paywall with a fake countdown): both caught every issue and built nothing that lost as the default.

One zip per skill below.
